summary: Structured Obligations Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting a scheduled September 15, 2026 distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-4 Long Term Certificates Series 2003-4 (CUSIP 81619PAD9). The trustee, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, reported $284,062.50 of interest received for the interest period ending on the distribution date, with each holder's pro rata share reported on Form 1099. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is stated. This is an ordinary ABS distribution notice, not a special situation; watch only for future trustee reports.
